train_racecar_zed_agent: train a DeepQ agent on the RacecarZEDGymEnv environment and save the model to a pickle file
create_cnn_to_mlp_model: create a CNN to MLP model with configurable convolutional layers and hidden layer sizes for DeepQ learning
run_deepq_learning: run DeepQ learning with configurable learning rate, timesteps, buffer size, and exploration parameters on a Gym environment
define_training_callback: define a callback function that stops training when episode rewards meet a threshold after minimum timesteps
save_trained_model: save a trained DeepQ agent model to a pickle file for later inference or evaluation
